_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: a level change of -4 and a slope change of -0.3 a month relative to the control site

agreement.claim: both engines report the same relative level and slope changes and the single-series comparators
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/quasi_examples.test.py fits the stacked interaction model and checks its group-by-period coefficients equal the difference series' to 1e-9, rebuilds the Newey-West SE by hand, and requires the single-series level change to be more than 1 below the truth.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: With site-specific noise SD 1 the slope miss (0.195) was close to the effect (0.3); the fixture uses SD 0.5. Measured by harness/quasi_examples.test.py, running python.py on seeds 0 to 99.

r: NeweyWest(fit, lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = FALSE)
